Comment:
Over-head greeting bubbles an NPC says when a player walks within 18 units (25 s cooldown per NPC). Keys are NPC guids (100000000000 + Npcs.json id); values are client string ids, one picked at random. Only each character's own authentic retail lines: the 2014 captures show only certain NPCs greeted, so there is no generic pool. Lines with markup can't be used; the client's bubbles render
but not . Sources: research/starting-area.md and the client string table.
